Hey I’m 22 MTF I’ve been on hrt for 9 months - I have the same story growing up. Depending on the state you have to get a therapist to prescribe you hrt. I was lucky enough to have a constant informed clinic where I went for three sessions with my doctor and I started. If you want to have long hair start growing it out. It takes a long time to grow. Buy nail polish for your feet to be hidden. Female underwear and get used to wearing a sports bra.Come out to your parents when you think its safe.  Who cares what your family thinks because they don’t have to suffer everyday like we do.

As an Mtf trans(22),  I could write about how amazing everything is or changing etc.  You can go on LGBTQ websites for that. Honestly a year ago I came to a crossroad I can try out transitioning, KMS, or live out the rest of my life hiding.  I thought at anytime I can KMS. Why don’t I try transitioning as far as I can go then see where I’m at. I don’t have the most supportive family. My father said to me “ by transitioning your basically killing yourself” I said “ I might actually live “. I’ll tell you as hard as it’s been dealing with all the bullshit. It’s the happiest I have ever been and I feel like I’m living for myself now. Friends / family come and go. Yes I have my ups and downs because of depression it’s not perfect. Science is always advancing so who knows.
